blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Kacey dela Rosa powered Gilas Pilipinas to twin victories over favorite Mongolia and lowly Macau on Tuesday to start its medal bid on a bright note in the women’s 3×3 U-23 basketball competition of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Dela Rosa scored the decisive baskets as Gilas prevailed over Mongolia, 17-12, before Maria Pasilang, Kennan Ka and Amyah Espanol spent most of the time on the court in the 21-4 rout of Macau at Kinju Futo Station Square.
